0022600127.text: The Nuggets, 1-1 and 1-0 at home, host the 0-3 Golden State Warriors in Denver's third game of the season, with Denver 7th in the West and 1.5 games back in the Northwest and Golden State on a three-game losing streak and 14th in the West. Denver is missing Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Alpha Diallo (wrist) and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandon Williams (back soreness), Charles Bassey (knee) and Gui Santos (knee tendinitis) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with Denver winning the last meeting 116-93 in Denver on March 29, 2026.
